ud4.9:1.1: evam me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane {Kalandakanivāpe}. atha kho āyasmato Upasenassa Vaṅgantaputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi: lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me satthā ca me bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, svākhyāte c' amhi dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, sabrahmacāriyo ca me sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā, sīlesu c' amhi paripūrakārī, samāhito c' amhi, ekaggacitto arahā c' amhi khīṇāsavo, mahiddhiko c' amhi mahānubhāvo, bhaddakaṃ me jīvitaṃ bhaddakaṃ maraṇan ti.
ud4.9:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato Upasenassa Vaṅgantaputtassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud4.9:3.1: yaṃ jīvitaṃ na tapati, maraṇante na socati, {sa've} diṭṭhapado dhīro, sokamajjhe na socati.
ud4.9:4.1: ucchinnabhavataṇhassa santacittassa bhikkhuno vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n' atthi tassa punabbhavo 'ti. ||9||
